root_cause: The current video analyzer returns video_frame_extract_failed for either frame extraction or audio extraction. The observed MP4 has no audio stream, so audio extraction fails and terminates video analysis although frame decode succeeds.

douyin_to_obsidian_comparison.behavior: Its existing-video flow catches audio extraction failure, skips ASR, and may continue visual processing.
douyin_to_obsidian_comparison.not_safe_to_copy_directly: Its script is a hard-coded Obsidian pipeline with unrelated configuration, paths, and write behavior.

recommended_minimal_repair: Make audio extraction optional after a successful video probe/frame extraction; report no_audio_stream distinctly; allow the existing visual path to continue; add a silent-MP4 regression test.
